signals_changed.note: No configured signal threshold was newly crossed and no active-set change occurred. pipeline.py mechanically advanced last_confirmed for the 10 carried canonical signals.

auto_detection.decision: No new zone met the auto-detection gate. Somalia had several official counterterrorism claims but not a single independently corroborated multi-source escalation event; Thailand-Cambodia showed armor procurement and competing accusations without a new kinetic event; Haiti remains a severe protracted gang conflict but the reachable UN material did not establish a fresh military threshold.

India Rajouri border-fire allegations remain without independent major-outlet or official exact-event corroboration.

allied_positions.NATO: NATO’s newest 20 July item is Ukraine’s emergency-response assistance request; it is not Article 5 or confirmation of allied combat entry. The 13 July Coalition of the Willing meeting remains the most recent force-posture item on the news page.
allied_positions.UN: UN News on 20 July called for renewed diplomacy in the US-Iran war, condemned the overnight Kyiv attack, and highlighted worsening hunger in Sudan. No UN/IAEA nuclear-use threshold surfaced.
allied_positions.South_China_Sea: AP reported both Philippine and Chinese official accounts of the Second Thomas Shoal altercation. No treaty invocation or new allied combat deployment was reported.

energy_oil.caveat: Instrument timestamps vary slightly by contract; vendor-reported 24-hour changes are used. Values are sanity-only and did not set tracker probabilities.
